{{Quote|You carry a lightsaber."''<br />''"It's a symbol of a Jedi&mdash;just like the insignia on Commander Irolia's uniform.|[[Wynssa Fel]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Force Heretic II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>}}
The '''insignia''' or '''symbol''' of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] was included on the shoulder patches of the [[Uniform of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|uniforms]] of personnel of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TORE" /> Another version of the insignia was in use during the [[Order of Zildrog campaign]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'' to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hess'irolia'nuruodo]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]] bore the insignia on her uniform.<ref name="Force Heretic II" />
